description.value: Hotel Lucerne is a boutique hotel at Amsterdam Avenue and 79th Street on the Upper West Side. It has an on-site French restaurant, Nice Matin, which is popular for brunch. The hotel is a short walk from Central Park and the Museum of Natural History.
